notes.title: Major content update - the Dead Lands!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the latest content update for our fantasy incremental game, featuring new buildings and mechanics to take your gameplay to the next level.

[h3]A new threat has emerged in our realms.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43582980/accb2f05d162242a59acfa2326ae629e8e54e1c0.png[/img]

[h2]New mechanic: combat[/h2]
You can now lead expeditions into the dead lands to gather the new mysterious energy and engage in battles against undead armies. Your victories will grant you new abilities and bonuses to help you progress further in the game.

[h2]Dark energy and the Dark shrine[/h2]
Newly discovered dark energy can be harnessed to improve your settlement. With it, you can build and upgrade the Dark Shrine, which enhances your production capabilities and provide new passive bonuses. You can also use dark energy to forge demonic weapons, to help you gain an edge in battle. But beware, using too much dark energy may have consequences.

[h2]New buildings: Barracks, Blacksmith, Mana pool, Dark shrine[/h2]
The barracks allow you to recruit and train more soldiers to conquer the enemy. The blacksmith enables you to forge and improve weapons, making your troops even stronger in battle. Finally, the mana pool allows you to convert your other resources into mana.

[h3]Gather your troops, forge powerful weapons, and prepare for battle![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43582980/e61676104fdc5966cc11282a8658e9c3bdda592a.png[/img]




[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]
Existing buildings

Town hall
- Decreased cost increment on Crowd control
- Decreased cost increment on Hard working
- Decreased cost increment on Population Prosperity
- Refunded prestige points spend on these upgrades, so users that upgraded those wouldnt have less prestige points.

Academy
- Fixed bug where treadmill crane effect would persist through prestige
New upgrades
- Demonic tools

New upgrades

- Dark dimension

New upgrades

New upgrades

Magic Tower
- golems can now be assigned to barracks
